subject.title: feat(android): add Skill Workshop settings panel

question: Should OpenClaw add first-party Android Settings controls for Skill Workshop proposal review and apply/reject/quarantine actions now, matching the existing Web/iOS/Gateway capability once proof and i18n are fixed?
rationale: The implementation reuses existing RPCs, but exposing proposal lifecycle actions in the released Android app is a product-surface decision rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor Android parity after fixes
options.body: Accept the Android Skill Workshop direction once the contributor refreshes i18n and adds live Android proof for the new panel and actions.

options.title: Narrow to read-only first
options.body: Ask the PR to expose list/inspect only and defer mobile apply/reject/quarantine until maintainers are comfortable with Android lifecycle actions.

options.title: Defer Android Skill Workshop
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers want Skill Workshop review to remain Web/iOS/CLI-only for now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Android parity after fixes
recommendation.body: Accept the Android Skill Workshop direction once the contributor refreshes i18n and adds live Android proof for the new panel and actions.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties the current Android settings shell and Skill Workshop controller/RPC surfaces most strongly to this account's merged work.
